name: Genki I & II
comment: A widely used beginner textbook series that introduces grammar systematically alongside reading, writing and listening exercises.

name: Tae Kim's Guide to Japanese
comment: A free online grammar guide that explains Japanese from its own internal logic, useful as a second explanation alongside a textbook.

name: NHK News Web Easy
comment: Simplified NHK news articles with furigana and audio — a source of authentic, level-appropriate reading practice.

name: WaniKani
comment: A spaced-repetition system that teaches kanji and vocabulary through radicals, building up in ordered levels.

name: JLPT Official Practice Workbook
comment: Official sample questions from jlpt.jp, useful for seeing the format and level of the actual examination.

name: Jisho.org
comment: An online Japanese-English dictionary that surfaces JMdict definitions and KANJIDIC2 readings.
